tools.name: search_shows
tools.description: Search theatre, musicals, concerts, comedy and other live events on sale on TIX in Australia and New Zealand, including discounted Lasttix deals. Returns titles, cities, dates, AUD from prices, discounts and the TIX show page URL. Filters combine; with no filters it returns what is on now and coming

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Details for one show on TIX: description, and each ticket option with venue, city, dates, AUD from price, whether it is a discounted Lasttix deal or a presale. Members-only prices are not included. Tickets are bought from the show page URL.

tools.name: show_cards
tools.description: Display up to 8 shows as cards with image, dates, price and a button to the TIX show page. Call search_shows first and pass the URLs of the shows you want to show.

tools.name: show_alert_link
tools.description: Get a link the person can open to sign up for TIX email alerts about a show (deals and presales for it, plus offers in their state; free, unsubscribe any time). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_shows, get_show, show_alert_link · Public sink: show_alert_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_shows, get_show, show_alert_link · Public sink: show_alert_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
